title: Anything I Want to Believe
description: Small modification adding interesting (I hope I guess) staff vanilla-looking like.
body:
## Features

- **Corporib**:

(Plant or mushroom?) growing under tree trunks in the forests.
Corporib can be crafted into its powder, and its powder can be crafted into diluted version or dough.

- **Corporib powders**:

Uses as ingredients to making stuff or as food (bad for your health).

- **Corporib arrow**:

Useful PVP/PVE projectile (like tipped (poisonous/instant damage) arrows) to debuff the hostiles and deal extra damage that ignores armor, effects and I-frames (invulnerability in half-second after taking damage).

- **On stick food**:

New food variation that lets you feed rideable animals and another players to heal or debuff them. There are effect stacking mechanic to deal a weak damage at first and increasing damage value with feeding.
